apiError.workspace_creation_closed: Each account has one business. Additional workspaces are no longer available.
apiError.plan_limit: This feature or user count requires another plan. Review the plan with the account owner.
apiError.workspace_unavailable: This workspace is unavailable. Review billing or switch workspace.
apiError.hosted_unavailable: This feature isn't available on Oruka-hosted installs yet.

capability.contactsDesc: Save a name, phone, email and notes to the CRM.

capability.knowledgeDesc: Search the documents you uploaded (prices, policies, catalogues).
capability.mediaDesc: Find, generate and send images, audio or video to the contact.
capability.calendarDesc: Check availability and book slots in Google Calendar.
capability.sheetsDesc: Log rows to a connected spreadsheet.
capability.remindersDesc: Schedule a nudge for a contact.
capability.paymentsDesc: Create a Stripe or Mercado Pago link and send it in the conversation.
capability.shopifyDesc: Look up your store's orders and products. Read-only.
capability.httpDesc: Call allowlisted hosts and the accounts connected on Connections.
capability.automationsDesc: List and propose playbooks. Proposals stay drafts until you approve them.
capability.codeDesc: Run Python in the sandbox. For internal analysis, not for answering customers.
prospect.title: Prospect stage
prospect.stale: New messages since the last assessment.
prospect.empty: Not assessed yet. The AI does it on its own every few minutes.
error.title: This page couldn't load
error.description: Reload to try again, or go back.
pagination.label: Pagination
apiError.invalid_json: We couldn't read the data that was sent. Please try again.
apiError.invalid_body: The data sent isn't valid. Check the form and try again.
apiError.unauthorized: Your session isn't allowed to do this. Please sign in again.
apiError.forbidden: You don't have permission for this action.
apiError.not_found: Sorry, this isn't available any more.
apiError.conflict: This changed while you were working. Refresh the page and try again.
apiError.unprocessable: We understood the request but couldn't complete it.
apiError.not_configured: This integration isn't set up yet.
apiError.rate_limited: Too many requests in a row. Wait a few seconds and try again.
apiError.upstream_failed: An external service didn't answer correctly. Try again in a moment.
apiError.timeout: That took too long to answer. Please try again.
apiError.server_error: Sorry, this isn't available right now. We're already working on it.
apiError.no_credentials: No valid model credential is set. Check Settings → AI model.
apiError.model_unavailable: That model isn't available on your account. Pick another one in the model picker.
apiError.generation_failed: The model couldn't produce a usable result. Try again or switch models.
apiError.nothing_to_update: There was nothing to update in this request.
apiError.no_recognized_keys: The file held no credential this app recognizes.
apiError.automation_has_blanks: Fill in the missing details in the flow before switching it on.
apiError.no_credits: Your included AI Credits have run out. Review the available plans under Account → Billing to continue.
apiError.elevenlabs_permission: The ElevenLabs API key is missing the {field} permission. Enable it at elevenlabs.io/app/settings/api-keys — Voices: Read and ElevenAgents: Write — then reload.
apiError.twilio_geo_blocked: Twilio isn't allowed to call that destination. Enable it in console.twilio.com > Voice > Settings > Geo Permissions, marking the country as Low risk.
apiError.twilio_trial_unverified: The Twilio account is on trial, so it only calls verified numbers. Verify the number in console.twilio.com > Phone Numbers > Verified Caller IDs, or add funds to leave trial.
apiError.twilio_trial_audio: Twilio is on Trial. Its audio restrictions prevent phone calls with the agent. Upgrade the account in Twilio Console, then refresh this page. You can test voice in the browser meanwhile.
apiError.twilio_account_inactive: The Twilio account is inactive. Review its status and balance in Twilio Console before calling.
apiError.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
apiError.network: We couldn't connect. Check your connection and try again.
apiError.offline: You appear to be offline. Check your internet connection.
error.critical.title: Sorry, the app isn't available right now
error.critical.description: Something unexpected broke. Reload to try again.

apiError.telephony_quote_expired: The quote expired or the price changed. Search again and confirm the current amount.
apiError.telephony_purchase_review: The purchase could not be confirmed. Refresh Purchased before trying again: Twilio may have processed it.
apiError.telephony_regulatory: This number needs identity or address approval. Complete the requirements in Twilio.
